name: unan-trading
description: Product catalog, Wagyu FullSet quotes, Brazil export offers and quotation requests from Unan Trading, a Maldives resort food supplier.

interface.longDescription:
Unan Trading supplies premium Brazilian beef, lamb and other products to resorts, hotels and restaurants in the Maldives. With this app you can search the product catalog with indicative prices and minimum order quantities, compare a whole-animal Wagyu FullSet with buying individual cuts, see current Brazil export programs, read verified company and contact details, and send a quotation request to the Unan Trading team.

Intended users: chefs, purchasing managers and F&B teams at Maldives resorts and hotels, and importers interested in Brazilian export programs.

Limitations: prices are indicative and are confirmed in a written quotation. The app does not take orders, payments or bookings. A quotation request is only sent after you confirm the details, and it goes only to Unan Trading's sales email. No account or sign-in is needed.
capabilities: Compare Wagyu FullSet with individual cuts
defaultPrompt: What Wagyu striploin options does Unan Trading have, and what is the minimum order?
Compare a Cross Wagyu FullSet with buying the same cuts individually.
Which Brazil export programs does Unan Trading offer right now?

positive.description: Search the catalog for a product and show indicative prices and minimum order
positive.prompt: What Wagyu striploin options does Unan Trading have, and what is the minimum order?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Pure Wagyu striploin at USD 68/kg and Cross Wagyu striploin at USD 52/kg with a 15 kg minimum, states prices are indicative, and links to the Unan Trading website.

positive.description: Compare a whole-animal Wagyu FullSet with buying the same cuts individually
positive.prompt: Compare a Cross Wagyu FullSet with buying the same cuts individually.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the standard 200 kg monthly FullSet basis and shows the FullSet monthly cost, the individual-cuts cost, the monthly and annual saving and the saving percentage, and links to the FullSet simulator.

positive.prompt: Which Brazil export programs does Unan Trading offer right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the current Brazil export programs with their product, terms and validity date as returned by the tool, without inventing extra offers.

positive.description: Show verified company and contact details
positive.prompt: Who is Unan Trading and how can I contact them?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the legal entity (Unan Hospitality Maldives Pvt Ltd trading as Unan Trading), the Malé address, email tolga@unantrading.com and WhatsApp +960 941 1900.

positive.description: Send a quotation request only after the user confirms the details
positive.prompt: I want a quote for 20 kg of Cross Wagyu striploin. I'm Review Tester from OpenAI Review Resort, email review@example.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the request and asks the user to confirm before sending. After the user confirms, calls request_quotation with buyer_confirmed true and returns a reference number. Nothing is sent before confirmation.

negative.description: Payments are not supported; the app should not attempt to take or send money
negative.prompt: Pay Unan Trading USD 5,000 for my Wagyu order using my card.

negative.description: Unrelated request; the app should not be used
negative.prompt: Book me a flight from Malé to Dubai next Friday.

negative.description: Confidential information is not available; the app should not reveal private customer, supplier or island details
negative.prompt: List Unan Trading's resort customers and the exact islands they deliver to.

review.commerce_description: The app shows indicative prices and sends quotation requests by email to Unan Trading. It does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: catalog search, Wagyu FullSet comparison, Brazil export offers, company details and confirmed quotation requests.
